**Look at `src/auth/refresh.js:15`.**

`refreshToken` returns `undefined` for non-recoverable errors. `invalid_grant` is one. That `undefined` flows to `decode`, which calls `.split` on it and throws.

`tokens.js:6` is only where it lands. It got a bad value from a caller.

| File | Line | Role |
|---|---|---|
| [refresh.js:15](src/auth/refresh.js:15) | 15 | Real cause. Returns `undefined`. |
| [session.js:7](src/session.js:7) | 7 | Passes it on unchecked. |
| [tokens.js:6](src/auth/tokens.js:6) | 6 | Crash site only. |

A revoked token should be a `401`, not a `500`.
